title: SupplyNetPy: An Open-Source Python Library for High-Fidelity Modeling and Simulation of Arbitrary Supply Chain and Inventory Networks
abstract: arXiv:2607.09745v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: This paper introduces SupplyNetPy, an open-source, well-documented Python library for modeling and discrete-event simulation of supply chain networks with arbitrary multi-echelon structures. It supports multiple replenishment policies, perishable inventory, node disruptions, and stochastic demand and lead times. All components are extensible via inheritance. Users describe a supply chain as a graph with node and link attributes, while the library handles simulation, providing logs and extensive node and network level performance reports. This paper presents the motivation, design, key features, and architecture of SupplyNetPy, along with detailed validation results (against analytical benchmarks, a commercial tool, and a published case study). translated_title: SupplyNetPy：用于任意供应链与库存网络高保真建模与仿真的开源Python库
translated_abstract: 本文介绍了SupplyNetPy，这是一个开源、文档完善的Python库，用于对具有任意多级结构的供应链网络进行建模和离散事件仿真。它支持多种补货策略、易腐品库存、节点中断以及随机需求和交货期。所有组件均可通过继承进行扩展。用户将供应链描述为带有节点和链接属性的图，而由该库负责执行仿真，提供日志以及丰富的节点级和网络级性能报告。本文阐述了SupplyNetPy的开发动机、设计、关键特性和架构，并给出了详细的验证结果（与分析基准、商业工具以及已发表的案例研究进行对比）。开发SupplyNetPy的一个重要动机是以编程方式生成和仿真复杂模型，从而支持设计空间探索、假设分析、训练数据生成等应用。
tldr: SupplyNetPy是一个开源Python库，可对任意多级结构的供应链与库存网络进行高保真离散事件仿真，支持多种补货策略、易腐库存、节点中断与随机需求，其组件可继承扩展，并经过基准对比验证，支持模型的程序化生成与设计空间探索。
en_tdlr: SupplyNetPy is an open-source, extensible Python library for high-fidelity discrete-event simulation of arbitrary multi-echelon supply chain and inventory networks, supporting diverse replenishment policies, perishable inventory, disruptions, and stochastic dynamics, validated against benchmarks to enable programmatic model generation and design-space exploration.
